headline: Bacterial Vaginosis Linked to Increased STI Co-Infection, Finds National Study of 1.5 Million Women from Quest Diagnostics
summary: Women who test positive for bacterial vaginosis (BV) were over three times more likely to also test positive for one or more non-viral sexually transmitted infections (STIs) than women who test negative for BV, according to a new Health Trends® study from Quest Diagnostics (NYSE: DGX) and Hologic, Inc.
